purpose.zh: 在分腿坐姿下练屈髋肌抬腿
purpose.en: Train the hip flexors to lift both legs in a straddle.

text.zh: 双腿伸直，同时抬离地面几厘米
text.en: Keep both legs straight and lift them a few centimetres off the floor

text.zh: 宽分腿坐，双手在两腿之间撑地，胸口前倾
text.en: Sit in a wide straddle, hands on the floor between your legs, chest forward.

text.zh: 髋部不离地，稍停再放下
text.en: Keep your hips down, pause, then lower.

commonErrors.en: Leaning back to lift the legs.

cautions.zh: 大腿前侧抽筋或髋部疼痛时停下休息
cautions.en: Stop and rest if the front of your thighs cramps or your hips hurt.
